subject: planner: push down not operator when to simplify predicate (#62943)
summary: Adds a centralized NOT-pushdown step to predicate simplification (via expression.PushDownNot) and removes redundant PushDownNot applications previously scattered across partition pruning, index merge path generation, physical plan partition pruning conditions, and stats derivation; also broadens expression logical-op classification to avoid redundant istrue wrapping.
